risk: Incorrect typed method dispatch can redirect authenticated writes or expose private transfer evidence; server scope and ownership remain authoritative.
justification: Reviewed all 86 transport method keys: the eight additions (getEventAdminAccess, listEventAdmins, createEventAdminInvitation, revokeEventAdminInvitation, removeEventAdmin, previewEventAdminInvitation, acceptEventAdminInvitation, issueCourtesyTickets) call the eight authenticated delegated event-administration and courtesy-ticket routes of EVT-ADMIN-DELEGATION-001. The keys are typed HTTP dispatch, not a selectable or business catalog; persisted event_admin_invitation, event_admin_member and ticket order rows and the server checks remain authoritative. The prior 78-method review is retained as previousDecision.
